headline: A Better Bid: The Tesla Salvage Boom -- More Wrecks, Higher Prices Than the Rest of the Market
summary: A Better Bid, a registered Copart auction broker providing global buyers access to salvage and clean-title vehicle auctions, today released internal data uncovering an underreported corner of the electric vehicle boom: what happens to these high-tech cars after a total loss.
